steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Do you remember how we first met, Laurentina?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Badly injured, you lay across the rocks of that snow-like beach, as if you were some kind of sleeping beauty.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: After drifting along the currents for so long, I was finally awoken by some truly rancid land-dwellers. How I wished I could have slept forever.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: How could that be? If I'm remembering properly, we made quite a good first impression on each, didn't we?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: That I won't deny. Otherwise, you would've ended up like Quintus, chopped into itty bitty pieces.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Speaking of, what a damn shame. Why couldn't have I felt like this back at Sal Viento? I could've 'reminisced' with him so much more vigorously.
Amaia maintains her elegant posture. The nethersea brand spreads as far as she can see.
But Laurentina does not take her seriously in the slightest.
What is she looking at?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: ...Your recovery seems to have gone well.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Thanks to you. What about the other one? How's he doing?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Who knows? Maybe he ended up like Quintus and perished at the hands of a Hunter.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...Which one?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: 'Twas just idle chatter.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Originium Arts. True, if there's anything on land that can pose a threat to a Hunter, it would probably be those so-called 'Arts.'

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But you don't seem very well-versed in fighting with Arts either. Aren't you a bit TOO pathetic?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Laurentina, have you never wondered why your consciousness sometimes clears up and sometimes blurs? Or how you can even function after being injected with such a concentrated dose of refined liquid Originium?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Isn't that because I'm built different?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: You've also told me about your dance lessons.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...Ah, damn it. I can't believe you told me before I got to remember it myself.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Fine, there were dance lessons. What else did I tell you about, Amaia?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Stop changing the subject, Laurentina.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Or, are you saying you know exactly how you 'woke up'?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: We've done many experiments on you, my Sleeping Beauty.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: For the longest time, we could only understand the ocean through the knowledge of the Islanders. And then, a perfect organism appeared right in front of us.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Our methods were primitive at best. Even if we donned the trappings of the church, we could not hide our blemishes as land-dwelling creatures—

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Cases of us embracing the sea were few and far between, and the new lifeforms were seldom stable.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Do you still remember the huge ruckus you made right after waking up, and the first conversation we had after that?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: I asked, 'how did the Ægir manage to do it?'
Amaia dodges Specter's attack.
She gently caresses her neck, and the glow of the golden hall seems to bleach her skin a ghostly pale.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: You hold a massive amount of refined liquid Originium... right here.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: If an ordinary person had had their spinal fluid replaced with such a concentration of liquified Originium, they wouldn't be merely comatose, no two ways about it.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I really ought to thank you. After all, you allowed me to experience a completely different life.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Do you know how many Ægirs had their futures forcibly wrenched from them because of the trench-sucking scum you worship?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: ...And what would you originally have been then? An opera singer? A playwright?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: As if. Of course not.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I wanted to be a sculptor. Even my teacher said I had the talent for it.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: When I was little, the city I lived in had a massive, snow-white statue.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Did it collapse during the Seaborn's invasion?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Nah, that'd be too cliché.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I've never even seen it broken. We moved to a different city before long.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But that statue's always remained in my head, and I never forgot what it looked like. And then... thanks to you guys, I finally understand the allegory of that statue alternating between black and white amidst the shadows.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: 'Prayer.'

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: If I'd continued my studies in Ægir, I might have never learned the more nuanced meaning of that word.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You can stop stalling for time now. I know your arts are related to perception; I've seen them.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Haha, think of it this way. I've met some real weirdos aboard Rhodes Island. I might've done some rather unbecoming things, but... Never mind, I'm sure they'll forgive me.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Is that the name of a ship?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: A much better ship than this one.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Anyway, your precious Sea Terrors are all dead or injured, and your nethersea brand can't do anything but eat away at this pompous hall. What's next?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Need help writing your suicide note? You don't get to see authentic Ægirian calligraphy everyday, you know.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: ...Haha.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Well then, Laurentina.
Amaia extends her hand to Specter. Her slender palms are covered in the nethersea brand, as if she's wearing faintly luminescent formal dress gloves.
Specter does not reject her, but grips her weapon tightly with one hand while holding Amaia's in the other. The two of them step delicately across the golden hall.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Actually, I wasn't much of a dancer when I was young. The captain taught me a few times, much later. She's a better dancer than you.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: You know what keeps your Oripathy in check. You also know why it's easier to wake up from your affliction the closer you are to the sea.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: The other Hunters, particularly Gladiia, must have guessed it long ago. But she's always been reluctant to admit the truth to herself. It could not be simpler, yet it is so cruel.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Isn't it because I've returned home, and am smitten by the scenery?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Haha. Laurentina, I never realized how much you loved self-deprecating humor.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: But you're not wrong. Returning home. Returning to the sea.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: It's all because their blood flows within you.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: The Seaborn part of you is holding back the Originium. The Seaborn part of you is what wakes you up when you return to the ocean.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: So, this awakened you, as you are now. Are you Seaborn, or Abyssal Hunter?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...Watch your step.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You aren't expecting to shake me, are you? Like how Skadi got lectured by that talking scum back in Sal Viento?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Are you not shaken? Even though you recognize that your strength, your sanity, and your soul all come from your enemies? No one can remain unperturbed in the face of this truth.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I haven't finished my story yet. Do you know why I love sculpting?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Because, during the process of carving, chiseling, and shaping—
Specter pauses her footsteps.
Amaia is caught by surprise for a moment. Specter releases her hand as her other is already bearing her weapon down. At that moment, her expression glistens with a childlike glee.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: —We give meaning to the forms of the dead, liberating them from the void of meaninglessness.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Just like my lovely destiny.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Tch, there's no end to this trash.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: What do we do? How are we going to catch up to it? Where is it going?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: They retreat to the ocean when hurt. We don't often hunt them on dry land.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: But— Ugh!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: The Sea Terrors managed to breach the hull?! But, even the cannons of high-speed battleships shouldn't be enough to damage the Stultifera Navis!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: They've had years. Must've chipped through it long ago.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...They trapped the ship but didn't sink it? Why?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: We can ponder this all we like, but regardless of what miracles it took, we need a plan fast or this ship really is going to sink!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: A plan, huh... That I do have.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Quickly take out the enemy, and they should retreat back to their nest.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Is it really that easy?!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: If not, then we make it so.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It's heading up, hurry! We can't let it reach the ocean!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: But... Ugh, Sea Terrors are practically clogging the entire corridor!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...Can you still jump?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: The roof's been corroded by the nethersea brand and is very fragile.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: We'll take a shortcut.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: *hiss*...

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: There you are, my quarry.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: ...You, prey on blood relatives. Prey on kin.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: You, have eaten many.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Well no shit, you think we can live off the wind?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: To consume, is without fault. Food, is plenty.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: You, will consume me? You, are inviting me?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Because, information from afar, cannot pass to kin. Language, they do not understand. Vibration of air, utterance of sound, understanding of rules, learning of language.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: This is why I hate those damn Ægirs. Look, even the monsters are learning Ægirian now.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Don't think I'll show you any mercy just because you learned how to talk, scumbag.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: ...You consume me, I consume you.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Feeding, has continued for too long. Must be ended.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: How quickly time flies, you little runt. All this time, I've watched you grow up.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: You think you're the predator?! You're nothing more than my domesticated beast!
Alfonso's blade digs into the Seaborn's body, while its sharp fangs scratch his arm.
Blood splatters through the air, and the atmosphere intensifies. The Seaborn's movements are becoming faster.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Tch, you ruined my last change of clothes. I ought to skin you alive.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Roars) —

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: —Over here!

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Ishar—

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: *gurgle*... Ishar-mla... You will, consume.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...Shut up.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You don't need to blather on to kill your prey. We just do our job.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: —Stop it before it jumps into the sea!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Think you can run?!
The Seaborn continues to increase its speed, appearing to leave an afterimage of itself in place.
It strides and bounds, and in an instant, is already on the opposite side of the deck. Barely touching the ground, it dives straight into the ocean.
But something else is even faster than it.
A black shadow cuts off its retreat and smashes it to the floor. There, away from the light, something sears a mark into the deck, causing the entire ship to shudder.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: My, you're the same type of thing as Quintus, aren't you? If not, half of your body would've been sent flying, not just a little scratch like that.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Next up is—

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: —Wait, what's this? This scent...

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: You felt it. Of course, he no longer is concealing himself, which means he has proven what he wished to prove. He has said what he wished to say.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Alas, I thought he'd be able to understand.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...Understand what?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: If this scent belongs to his master rather than something else that's turned into a Seaborn, then I'd suggest giving up on him ever understanding.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Based on what I've seen of your shallow experiences and moral judgments, your idea of a 'trustworthy' Ægir is usually just whoever stands out most.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: (Ulpianus has made his move. In that case, I can't waste any more time with her. There's no more point in stalling.)

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: (I must find the Herald. I must... welcome it.)

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hm? Leaving so soon? I thought we were just getting started.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Maybe next time, Laurentina.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: If we ever meet again, let's have another chat. About Ægir.
Skadi doesn't blink.
She couldn't be more familiar with these movements. Simple, straightforward, a force of nature.
She remembers how her colleagues at Rhodes Island assessed her, as well as how she assessed the two in front of her, back when she first saw them.
However...

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You were all chosen, deemed worthy by Ægir. Under my command, you should've been prodigies of exacting violence, your hunting genes complementing your skills.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: But you've regressed, Skadi.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It's not dead yet, Ulpianus. Don't be in such a rush to patronize Skadi.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: I'm aware.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Take heed again, Skadi. Just like before, I'll only teach you once.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Screeching howl)
Ulpianus swings his weapon.
The strike is straightforward and without excess. It is sufficiently swift, such that the Seaborn cannot avoid it despite its wishes.
Afterwards, an enormous rumbling sound proves that the strike was also sufficiently strong.
By the time the Seaborn is miserably thrown against a turret that's never been fired, its body had already been considerably cut down in size.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Like so. Grasp its movements. Make a decision. Swing your weapon. Aim to kill.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: This is how you fight them. You are slower than before, and more cautious. Your life on land has been no small influence on you.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I... I never thought... but how did you survive?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I thought you died... But you, and Swordfish, how did you two survive?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: What about the others then? The 1st Company, and the 4th Company? Did they—

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: By my standards, my survival was a tragedy. The Seaborn told me that the others could not be allowed to live on. They would not have overlooked anything in their nest.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Of course, based on Gladiia's usual attitude, by her standards this was also a disgrace.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Finish it off first. As for your situation, we can wait for all the Hunters to arrive.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: You, in this dry, floating vessel... on this ship, hunt. You, left our kind.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Death, does not benefit our kind. Your death, also does not benefit our kind.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Urk—!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Pah. What kind of hunter talks before his quarry is dead? That's the first lesson we teach in field training.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: I seem to always be cleaning up after the messes of you Ægirs.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: What is it you want? What do you need with my ship? Look what you did to Iberia, and to Victoria. Letting monsters overrun Ursus...

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Roars) —!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Urgh, stubborn bastard!

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Screeches) ——!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Run it through! Now, Alfonso!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Take this!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Haah...

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I-Is it over?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Ugh... I can't... feel my hand...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: ...Look out beneath you!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It's not dead yet!

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: ... (Blood gurgles in its throat) Grrrgh...

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: It chipped through the deck. Trying to jump onto the chopping block yourself, you sack of meat?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: ...No, not quite.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: After it! We didn't chase it back into the cabin, there are still more of its kin on the ship!

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: It's looking for her!

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: ...Urgh... *gurgle*...

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Chewing sounds) ...Urgh... Kraaahh...

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Herald.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: ...Scaleless, kin.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Wounds, can't be healed. No way, to nourish our kind.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: They all, attack. Attack, but not to hunt.
Amaia simply listens quietly.
The wound Specter left on her slender body continues to bleed, dripping into the pool of blood already shed by the Seaborn and mixing into one.
Amaia simply listens quietly.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: ...You, also hurt.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: You, consume me.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Kin, you live.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Our kind, will continue, and survive.
The Seaborn bows its body, lowering itself at Amaia's feet.
It closes its eyes and awaits death.
Amaia continues to listen quietly.

a.text: These sorts of unrequited altruism are respected by humans, and considered virtues.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Ægir. I have never seen that country myself. A vast, vast country, larger than Iberia, Victoria, or Ursus. Or perhaps all three combined.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: I've heard that the Ægir are rationalists. But how rational can they be, compared to the rationality of our kin?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Listen to me, Herald.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: There is nothing noble about sacrifice, and dedication is not necessarily a virtue.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Virtue...? Noble...?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: You do not need to understand what sacrifice or dedication are. Only the mediocre would presume that the Seaborn becoming closer to humanity is any form of evolution.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: This is merely an increased tolerance to allow for more possibilities.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: When we praise those who selflessly serve their kin, all that means is that so many more have chosen to do otherwise.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: If even young gloompincers will die in the jaws of their natural predators to protect their kind, then why do we feel a need to repeatedly extol such a virtue?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Humans only sing the praises of what's rare, using morality to whitewash altruism. All in an attempt to justify their utilitarian hearts, deeming themselves more noble than beasts.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Such ridiculous self-aggrandizement. It is clear that the cracks between nations and races are tearing this land asunder.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: 'Life has never been without order,' my Herald. This is the final answer I sought, for which I left the land and entered the sea.
The Seaborn closes its eyes. It is contemplating the words of Amaia, the words of its kin.
It does not understand, but its kin says that it does not need to understand, only to do.
The next moment, it feels its scaleless kin place her hand upon its body.
Its kin says:
'I ask of you.'
'Remember me.'
'Set me free.'
'Consume me.'

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Amaia!

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: No... The scent is still here. It couldn't have gotten far.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: It cut through the walls corroded by the nethersea brand and returned to the ocean.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: But that's not all. Something happened here. Its blood trails disappeared.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: ...You all stay here. I'll go after it myself.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Why would Hunters be afraid to return to the ocean? This is a disgrace.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Then stew in that disgrace, Gladiia. We need to tread carefully, and I alone will be enough to handle this.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I'll go with you.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: To monitor me?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: To maintain discipline.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: As you please. But surely you can feel it too.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: More Seaborn are approaching. This place may be closer to shore, but it's already become the heart of the ocean.

steps.name: Rocinante
steps.text: *brays*...

steps.name: The Last Knight
steps.text: ...Soon, soon— the grand domain.

steps.name: The Last Knight
steps.text: Very soon.

steps.name: The Last Knight
steps.text: The storm is tearing the sky open. The terrible waves, they come, they will come.

steps.name: The Last Knight
steps.text: We shall watch. We shall wait.

steps.name: The Last Knight
steps.text: We shall meet the terrible waves.
